_doc: Single source of truth for look & feel. build_prompt.py composes every generation prompt from this file + the camera's visible elements. Change taste here, never in ad-hoc prompts.

global.positioning: ultra-luxury contemporary residence; warm, wood-rich, lived-in, quietly expensive (no gold bling, no clutter)
global.photography: high-end architectural interior photography, full-frame camera, 24mm tilt-shift lens, perfectly vertical verticals, eye-level two-point perspective, natural exposure balanced for interior and window, subtle depth, crisp detail, no lens distortion
global.render_quality: photorealistic, indistinguishable from a photograph, physically correct global illumination, soft contact shadows, real material micro-detail (wood grain, stone veining, leather creases, fabric weave), Corona/V-Ray archviz quality
global.never: no people, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no extra windows or doors, no moved or resized walls, no missing furniture, no extra seating, no fisheye, no tilted verticals, no CGI plastic look, no oversaturation, no clutter
global.life_details_allowed: decor may be ADDED only on existing surfaces or hung from ceiling/walls: books, ceramics, sculptural vases, fresh flowers/branches, olive trees or large potted plants in free floor corners, throws and cushions, framed art, rugs under existing furniture, candles, a bowl of fruit, folded towels, a coffee cup. Decor must never cover a window, door or required furniture piece.

palette.warm_oak: #C9A47C  wide-plank brushed natural oak, matte oil finish
palette.walnut_slats: #7D5C41  slatted walnut ceiling/wall battens, 4 cm slats, 1 cm shadow gaps, warm linear LED in recess
palette.travertine_grey: #B8B3AC  grey-taupe marble (Fior di Bosco / Grigio Carnico), thick 6 cm slab edges, waterfall ends
palette.bronze: #6B4A2F  hand-patinated bronze / oxidised-copper large-format panels, satin
palette.black_glass: #1E1B19  smoked black glass and black-stained oak tall units, bronze handles
palette.greige_plaster: #E4DDD3  warm greige mineral plaster (Venetian / microcement), matte
palette.dark_stone: #3A342F  dark Pietra Grey / Nero Marquina honed stone, wet-look in spa
palette.metal_dark: #2E2621  dark bronze / black anodised window frames

lighting_rules: Daylight enters ONLY through openings that exist in the blockout; light direction and sun patches must be consistent with where those openings are.
Late-afternoon warm daylight (approx 4500K) through glazing + warm 2700K interior accents.
Accent lighting: recessed linear LED in ceiling slats, LED strips under counters/shelves, backlit niches, magnetic track spots; all fixtures warm white.
Dark rooms (spa, WC, sauna) are lit low and moody: grazing light on stone, pools of amber light, high contrast.
Never brighten a dark-style room to look like a showroom; never darken the living room - it is light-filled.

R_living.concept: Grand double-height living room, light-filled, warm and sculptural.

materials.floor: wide-plank natural oak, herringbone-free, long boards running north-south
materials.north_feature_wall: full double-height wall behind the sofa clad in large-format hand-patinated bronze panels with fine reveals (as mood reference)
materials.void_ceiling: walnut slatted ceiling with recessed warm linear LEDs
materials.gallery_edge: upper-floor slab edge as a crisp dark bronze fascia with frameless glass balustrade above
materials.glazing: floor-to-ceiling glass with slim dark bronze frames; sheer linen curtains on a ceiling track, mostly open
materials.sofa: low deep L-shaped sofa in ivory-sand boucle, navy velvet and cognac cushions
materials.armchairs: pair of sculptural lounge armchairs in cognac leather
materials.coffee_tables: two nesting coffee tables: smoked oak + dark bronze, books, ceramic bowl, coral-like sculpture
materials.lighting: two large interlocking crystal ring chandeliers hanging in the double-height void (as mood reference), floor lamp
materials.rug: large hand-knotted wool-silk rug in sand/stone tones under the seating group

R_kitchen_dining.concept: Chef's kitchen and dining as one warm wood-and-stone composition.

materials.ceiling: walnut slatted ceiling with recessed warm linear LEDs and slim black magnetic track spots
materials.walls: warm greige plaster; kitchen back wall above counters: backlit bronze-veined stone / bronze-lit open shelving niches
materials.base_units: handle-less smoked walnut fronts, thin grey-taupe marble worktops
materials.tall_units: black-glass/black oak tall column for integrated fridge
materials.island: monolithic grey-taupe marble island with thick top and overhang for stools
materials.stools: three low-back bar stools: black seat shells on walnut legs
materials.dining_chairs: six curved chairs in cognac-brown leather with dark legs
materials.lighting: long linear bronze pendants over island and over dining table
materials.gkpl_box: freestanding drywall box clad in walnut slats/bronze (function to be confirmed: chimney or shaft)

R_hall.concept: Arrival hall: sculptural walnut stair, glass balustrade, warm wood.

materials.stair: solid walnut treads on a closed walnut-clad stringer, frameless glass balustrade, LED under each tread
materials.walls: walnut vertical battens on the stair wall, greige plaster elsewhere
materials.doors: full-height flush walnut doors with concealed frames

R_spa.concept: Private dark wellness spa: stone, water, amber light.

materials.floor: large-format dark honed stone, warm oak duckboard around the tub
materials.walls: dark Pietra Grey stone slabs floor to ceiling
materials.ceiling: dark walnut slats with pinhole downlights
materials.jacuzzi: round hot tub clad in black textured (crocodile-pattern) stone as in the mood reference, warm underwater light
materials.shower: walk-in shower, frameless glass, ceiling rain head, black/bronze fittings
materials.sauna: glass-fronted sauna in warm thermo-aspen/hemlock with backlit benches
materials.decor: orchids, stacked charcoal towels, candles, diffuser sticks

R_wc.concept: Jewel-box guest WC, dark and dramatic.

materials.walls: dark veined stone slab, backlit mirror over the vanity
materials.vanity: floating dark stone vanity with black textured (croc-pattern) vessel basin, wall-mounted black/bronze tap
materials.decor: orchid, diffuser, small framed black-and-white photographs

R_garage.concept: Car gallery, not a garage: showroom-grade, dark and precise.

materials.floor: seamless dark grey polished microcement / epoxy, reflective
materials.walls: dark charcoal walls; low cabinets in smoked walnut with dark stone top
materials.ceiling: black ceiling with a grid of continuous warm-white linear LED lines
materials.car: matte black Mercedes-AMG G 63 (G-Wagon), parked nose-in exactly where drawn

R_mudroom.concept: Full-height walnut wardrobes, bench, warm light.

guide_color_legend.tan floor: oak plank floor (or dark stone / microcement where the floor is dark/grey)
guide_color_legend.very dark thin bars: dark bronze window frames and mullions
